header.source: KNOWLEDGE · etymology joined to atoms, anon door

rows.definition: The present day. In this house, a word that may cover a stretch far longer than one turn of the earth.
To move between two states by the same action. A toggle remembers where it is; that is its whole function.
Part of a named platform's name. A cut fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word.
A small thing standing for a larger right or meaning. A token carries authority it does not itself contain.
To break a stream into the smallest units that mean something. Where the boundaries fall decides what can be understood.
That which decides where one unit of meaning ends and the next begins. Its boundaries become everything downstream's assumptions.
Able to hold difference without breaking — accepting variation by design; of systems, forgiving of the unexpected.
The plain configuration format spoken as a word — obvious, minimal, human-readable settings.
The day after this one — the nearest future, always arriving; where unfinished songs wait without pressure.
A sound's character beyond its pitch — warmth or edge in the voice; in color, one step of a hue.
A language — the shaped speech a people share.
A made thing that serves a doing — a verb given a body and offered to any hand.
A brief explanation offered at the point of confusion. Help placed where the question arises rather than where answers are kept.
The highest part, or the beginning of a reading order. Position given weight by direction.
What a thing is about. A topic gathers things by their subject rather than their form.
The outermost tier — what stands at the root, containing everything beneath it.
The whole amount when everything is counted. A total is only as honest as the set it counted.
Contact between two things. The sense that cannot be exercised without being exercised upon.
A mark left by something's passing, and the following of such marks. Both make an absent thing knowable.
A path left by passage, and the following of it. Also one recorded piece among several.
That which follows a thing's state over time and reports it. A tracker records; whether it also surveils depends on whose consent it holds.
A practice handed on because it was found worth keeping. Tradition carries reasons that are often no longer stated.
Shaping a capacity by repeated exposure. Training changes what a thing does without telling it why.
The lasting characteristics by which a thing is recognised. A trait describes a tendency, never a verdict.
Exchanges completed as single units — either wholly done or not at all. A transaction leaves no half state.
Going past a limit that had defined the thing. Transcendence does not remove the limit; it stops being bounded by it.
To write across from one form to another — speech to text, practice to code — changing medium, never meaning.
Speech written down as it was said. A transcript's worth is that it does not tidy.
To change a thing's form while keeping its truth — the shape moves, the meaning holds. The lawful change, as against mutation unasked.
The completed act of changing form while keeping truth — the noun the verb transform leaves behind.
Carrying the power to change form — what leaves its subject truly different, and truer.
That which changes a thing from one form into another. Also the named architecture much of current machine language work is built on.
The passage between two states. The interval itself, held as a thing with its own duration and shape.
Between phases — the state of a thing caught mid-change, lawfully neither what it was nor yet what it becomes.
That which carries a thing across from one state to another. It holds the interval so the change is not abrupt.
To carry meaning into another tongue. A translation is a second saying, never a copy.
Concerning the carrying of meaning across a boundary. Of work that makes one domain reachable from another.
The same meaning carried into another tongue. A translation is a second saying, never a copy.
One who carries meaning across a boundary of form without adding their own. A translator succeeds invisibly; only the failures have a texture.
A change so deep the thing becomes another kind. Transmutation is not alteration — what comes out is not what went in.
The condition of being seen through — how a thing works, visible to those it affects. Transparency is structural, not a promise.
The carrying of a thing from one place to another. Transport moves and does not transform.
Something that lets you in and not out. A trap is defined by asymmetry, not by malice.
A wound that keeps shaping behaviour long after the event. Trauma is not the memory — it is what the body learned and never unlearned.
To go from one place to another. In this record, also the standing question of what may leave the house and under whose consent.
A branching structure where every part has one parent and may have many children. It grows outward and never rejoins.
The direction a series is moving over time. A trend describes the past and is constantly mistaken for the future.
Three taken together as one. Three is the smallest number that can hold a majority and a dissent at once.
The small thing that releases a much larger one. A trigger supplies no force; it only removes what was holding it.
To cut away the excess at the edges — tidying that respects the body; whitespace's barber.
Three taken together as one unit. Three is the smallest number that can hold a majority and a dissent.
The honest name for a thing gone wrong — stated with its reason, never as shame; the task-state that asks for eyes.
To cut a thing short at a limit. Truncation loses the end and rarely says how much.
The cutting short of a thing at a limit. Truncation loses the end, and honest systems say how much.
Acting on another's word without verifying it. Trust is a decision to accept exposure, which is what makes it worth something.
What is actually so, whether or not it is believed. Truth is not settled by agreement, and stating it honestly is a separate act from knowing it.
Short form of TypeScript. A named language rather than a concept.
A hollow cylinder that carries something along its length. As it appears here, part of a named platform's name.
To adjust until resonant — an instrument to true pitch, a sound to its intended shape. The bringing of a thing into agreement with itself.
A way carried through what would otherwise block it. A tunnel does not remove the obstacle; it passes under.
The hour between lights — day and night holding hands; a violet-grey palette named for it.
A named live-streaming platform. Also a small involuntary movement — context decides which.
A named short-form social platform. In this record, where the voice went during the seven-year silence.
One more than one. The smallest number at which relation becomes possible.
The extension marking a plain text file. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
A kind, recognised by the marks its members share. From the impression a blow leaves behind - the shape struck once and repeated after.
The typed tongue this house's apps speak — JavaScript wearing declared shapes, checked before it runs.
The craft of setting written language so it can be read well. How words look is part of what they say.
The surface where a system and a person meet. Everything a user believes about a system, they learned here.
Last, and beyond which there is no further. Ultimacy is a claim easy to make early.
Not yet given to a holder or a doer. Unassigned is an honest state and a quiet risk.
Acting without the standing to do so. Unauthorised is about permission, not about identity.
Existing but not reachable now. Unavailable is not absent, and confusing the two is a common error.
Not verified, or not selected. Both mean a state that was never confirmed.
Not yet placed under a named class. Unclassified is an honest state and not an absence.
Beneath, in place or law — the joining word of what supports and what is governed.
The low line joining words, and a mark of emphasis. Both bind or stress what they sit beneath.
To hold a thing well enough to act rightly on it. Understanding is not information; it is fit between a mind and a thing.
To take back a step. Undo is what makes trying things survivable.
Made one out of what was several. Unification keeps the parts and removes the seams.
The joinings of many into one, spoken plural — in types, a value lawfully one-of-several; in people, strength gathered.
The only one of its kind. Uniqueness is a claim about a whole set, which is why it is so often overstated.
A single standard amount, by which other amounts are counted. A unit is an agreement before it is a measure.
To remove what was holding a thing closed. Unlocking grants access that already existed behind the barrier.
Not yet worked on. Unprocessed is an honest state and the ground refined things must be traceable back to.
To end a standing arrangement one had agreed to. The existence of this act is what made the agreement real.
The direction away from the ground — rising's own word, smallest and oldest.

To bring a thing current — the change that keeps a record true to the present without discarding what it was. The most-spoken verb in the house's code, and the quiet promise inside it: what exists is tended, not replaced.
That which brings a thing to its newer state. Updating changes what exists rather than making anew.
To move to a newer or higher form. An upgrade is a claim of improvement and is not always one.
To send a held thing outward into a system that keeps it. The crossing from one's own ground to another's.
On, with weight in it — the joining word of resting and depending.
Higher of two, and of capital letters. Both are the raised form.
How much of the time a thing was actually available. Uptime is measured by those who needed it, not by those who ran it.
How little time remains before a thing must be done. Urgency ranks by clock, not by importance, and the two are constantly confused.
A string identifying a resource, whether or not it says how to reach it. It names before it locates.
An address by which a resource can be reached. It says where, not what.
How a thing is actually used, as against how it was meant to be. Usage is evidence; intention is only a claim.
To put a thing into service for what it can do. Also the custom that repeated employment hardens into.
One who puts a thing into service. An agent named only by the act, which is why the word says nothing about who they are.
The name a person is known by within a system. Chosen rather than given, and often more theirs than their legal one.
The world's common reference time, from which local times are offsets. A shared zero so records can be compared.
Utility shortened to its drawer name — the small helper that serves many hands and belongs to none. The humblest word in any codebase, and among the most used.
Usefulness, and a small tool built for one job. Named for what it serves rather than what it is.
How it is to be the person using a thing. UX is the whole felt experience, of which the visible surface is only part.
Short form of version, and of value. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
The open places, spoken plural — seats unfilled, parcels unclaimed; emptiness that is an invitation, honestly listed.
Whether a state is pleasant or unpleasant. The first of the three axes a feeling is located on, and the one most often mistaken for the whole.
Sound enough to stand. Its root is strength rather than correctness — able to bear weight.
To confirm a thing is sound enough to stand. To find it able to bear weight, which is not the same as finding it true.
The act of finding a thing sound enough to stand. Its root is not correctness but strength - to validate is to confirm something can bear weight.
The checker given a name — the entity whose one duty is saying whether a thing holds to its law.
What a thing is worth. From the same root as strength and valour - value is not price but the capacity to hold up.
A named place whose contents may change. The name stays; what it holds does not.
One lawful form among siblings — the same essence wearing a different face. A variant differs by design, never by drift.
Short form of variables — named places whose contents may change. The name stays; what it holds does not.
Welcome, in Icelandic. A greeting kept in its own tongue rather than translated.
Speed together with direction. Velocity says where as well as how fast, which is what separates it from speed.
One who supplies goods or services for payment. Named by the exchange rather than the relationship.
A named payment service. A named tool rather than a concept.
An isolated environment holding one project's dependencies. Separation so that projects cannot break each other.
The hosting platform this house deploys to. A named tool rather than a concept.
The spoken outcome of weighing — judgment delivered after evidence, owned by the one who gives it.
The establishing that a claim is so, by checking rather than trusting. Verification is what turns belief into finding.
Checked rather than assumed. Verification is a claim about method, not about confidence.
To establish that a claim is so, by checking rather than by trusting. Verification is the difference between believing and knowing.
One dated state of a thing among its several. Versions let a thing change without losing what it was.
Running up and down. Aligned with the pull of gravity, which is why it reads as height.
A thing that holds, and a thing that carries. The same word for the cup and the ship - and for a living body understood as either.
Rapid movement back and forth about a rest position. What sound, touch and colour all turn out to be underneath.
Moving pictures held so they can be shown again. Time recorded rather than a moment.
What is visible from a particular position. A view is always partial, and the position is part of the meaning.
One who looks, and the thing that lets them. Named from the side of the seeing.
The opening through which a larger thing is seen. What the viewport excludes still exists.
The watch kept while others rest — sustained attention as an act of care.
Who may see a thing. Visibility is a permission wearing the clothes of a property.
Able to be seen. Visibility is a fact about the viewer's position as much as about the thing.
The seen-before-built — what a thing intends to become, held clearly enough to steer by.
To go where one does not live, and to leave again. A visit assumes a host and a return.
One who comes where they do not live and will leave again. A visitor assumes a host and a return.
Belonging to sight. Of what is met by the eye rather than by the other senses.
Data given a form the eye can read at once. A visualisation is an argument made of shapes.
That which turns data into something the eye can read. It changes the form and should not change the finding.
The particular sound of one speaker, and their right to be heard. Both the recognisable manner and the standing to use it.
Empty space with nothing in it. Also to make null — the same word for an absence and for the act of creating one.
How much space a thing occupies, and how loud it is. Both are amounts of presence.
A stated preference counted alongside others. A vote converts many wills into one decision, at the cost of the minority's.
A promise made binding by the one who made it rather than by any enforcer. A vow costs exactly when keeping it is hard.
Visual Studio Code shortened to its working name — the editor half the house's building happens inside.
A named framework for building interfaces. A named tool rather than a concept.
The open places where harm could enter, spoken plural — named honestly so they can be tended, never advertised.
To move on foot, unhurried. Also to traverse a structure node by node — both take the whole path rather than jumping.
A made thing offered to others. Goods considered from the side of the one who made them.
Holding gentle heat — the temperature of welcome; in color, the reds and ambers; in voice, the kindness.
A signal that harm is possible if nothing changes. A warning must be spent carefully, since ignored ones stop being read.
To clean by passing water over. Also a thin layer of colour laid across a whole.
The element that flows and gives life — in this house's spring, one standalone tool: born of need, given freely.
The uncompressed audio format spoken as a word — sound kept whole, every sample present.
A disturbance travelling through a medium without carrying the medium with it. What moves is the pattern, not the water.
The shape a wave makes over time. A waveform is sound made visible without being made audible.
The speaker together with others. In this record, a word used deliberately of a family that includes kin who are not human.
To carry on the body — clothing, a name, a face shown daily; and the slow honest cost of use.
To cross separate threads until they hold as one cloth. Nothing is added but the crossing.
A network of linked things, and the thing a spider makes. Both hold by many small connections rather than one strong one.
An address one system gives another so it can be told when something happens. A standing invitation to be interrupted.
A named browser engine. A named tool rather than a concept.
A channel held open so both sides may speak whenever they have something. Conversation rather than question and answer.
The thread carried across the warp; the crossing that turns strung lines into cloth.
How heavily a thing bears, and how much it counts. Both the load and the importance.
To receive another gladly into a place that is yours. Welcome is a decision the host makes before the guest arrives.
A shaft sunk to reach water held below. A well gives nothing new — it reaches what was already there.
Of or toward the west. A bearing made into a description of a region.
Which thing. The word that opens an asking about identity or content.
The circle that carries — rolling motion, cycles, and the oldest machine still turning.
Speech without voice, meant for one hearer. A whisper carries less sound and often more weight.
Returning all light rather than absorbing it. Also the state of a surface before anything is put on it.
The erasable shared surface — thinking made visible, together, and wiped clean without loss of what it taught.
Of large extent across. Width buys coverage and costs concentration.
Wider than tall by a marked ratio. Width chosen so more can be held in one view.
A small self-contained interface part doing one job. Named vaguely on purpose, since the point is that it is interchangeable.
How far a thing reaches across. The measure of a span at right angles to its length.
The faculty of choosing and holding to it. Also what is set down for after one's death — both are a person's intent made to outlast a moment.
An opening that lets through without letting in. Also the bounded stretch a system can hold at once.
Knowing which knowledge applies now. Wisdom is judgment about knowing rather than more of it.
Alongside, or by means of. Names accompaniment or instrument.
Lacking, or outside of. Names an absence as a condition.
To see a thing and be able to say it was so. A witness does not judge; a witness attests.
The smallest unit of language that stands alone and means. A word is an agreement before it is a sound.
Effort directed at an end, and the made thing that results. Both the doing and what the doing leaves behind.
The ordered path work actually takes from start to done. A workflow is a description before it is a rule.
